author: Varun Mayya
description:
In this conversation, we sit down with Adel Sajan, Group Managing Director of Danube Group, to talk about Dubai’s real estate market and the story behind the Shahrukhz Residences by Danube. We get into why competition keeps pushing developers to innovate, and how Dubai compares with India on property prices, amenities, and rental yields.

We then talk about how Danube grew from selling building materials to retail and property, and how Adel gets employees to think like owners. He shares his approach to incentives, sharing business numbers with his team, and promoting people from within. We also discuss how he’s using AI and technology to speed up design and make faster decisions.

The goal of this conversation is to understand how to build a business that keeps growing, get people invested in its success, and keep finding new opportunities as the market changes.
